basic_info.description: Urban luxury dwelling in San Francisco's Theater District on famous Market Street! Light-filled studio condo, situated on the top floor, offers views that will captivate your senses. With its convenient location, you can indulge in a delightful day of shopping and dining in vibrant neighborhoods of Hayes Valley, Mission Bay  and Union Square, close by. If you're in the mood for a different vantage point, head up to the stunning shared roof deck. From here, you can take in the awe-inspiring bird's eye scenery while enjoying the company of fellow residents. The roof deck also boasts additional amenities, including a dog run and a barbecue area, providing you with a variety of options for relaxation and socializing.This exquisite unit is part of a boutique building that was meticulously crafted in 2018 from the historic Grauman's Imperial Theater. With only 90 units in the building, you'll experience a sense of exclusivity and community. Inside the condo, you'll be greeted by elegant wood floors that add warmth and sophistication to the space. The gorgeous kitchen features modern stainless steel appliances, ensuring that your culinary endeavors are a pleasure. Additionally, the convenience of in-unit laundry adds practical touch to daily routine. Why settle for renting? Not a BMR!
